title: everyday sheet metal, a second round: a lipped tray, a Z bracket with holes, a bent tab, a rolled hem, a tear-drop hem

cases.name: c001

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a sheet metal plate (60 × 40, 1.5 thick) with a 20 × 15 tab added on its far edge, bent 90° up along a line across the tab at y = 45

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a sheet metal plate (50 × 40, 1.5 thick) with a flange 25 up its far edge, the flange's top edge rolled 240° (inner radius 1)

cases.description: a sheet metal plate (50 × 40, 1.5 thick) with a flange 25 up its far edge, the flange's top edge hemmed as a tear drop 6 long (inner radius 1)
